command: set -e; EXPECTED=835e1b6ee6403c6444347728e4e448c530cd9773; ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo expected=$EXPECTED actual=$ACTUAL; test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; GRADLE="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; "$GRADLE" :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug; echo '=== SCAN HIGH PORTS ==='; OPEN=$(seq 30000 50000 | xargs -P 256 -n1 sh -c 'nc -z -G 1 192.168.0.100 "$0" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$0"' | sort -n | tr '\n' ' '); echo open_ports=$OPEN; SERIAL=''; for PORT in $OPEN; do adb connect 192.168.0.100:$PORT >/tmp/aicallbridge-adb-connect.txt 2>&1 || true; cat /tmp/aicallbridge-adb-connect.txt; CAND=$(adb devices -l | awk '$2=="device" && /model:SM_S906B/ {print $1; exit}'); if [ -n "$CAND" ]; then SERIAL=$CAND; break; fi; done; rm -f /tmp/aicallbridge-adb-connect.txt; echo '=== DEVICES ==='; adb devices -l; if [ -z "$SERIAL" ]; then echo adb_recovered=false; exit 0; fi; echo adb_recovered=true serial=$SERIAL; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/dev/null; STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo call_state=$STATE; test "$STATE" = "0"; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; for RATE in 16000 48000; do echo === construct_$RATE ===; set +e; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.CallAssistantAudioProbe construct $RATE"; RC=$?; set -e; echo construct_${RATE}_exit=$RC; done; echo phase1c_build_scan_offcall_complete=true
